name: Liberty to ECS Modernization
description: Assess a Java 8 / WebSphere Liberty application carrying planted modernization blockers, score it with the APEX ecs-modernize skill, then execute both migration paths on ECS — Replatform as-is onto ECS on EC2 and Rearchitect onto Fargate — and re-assess to see the Fit_Score rise from the Replatform band into the Rearchitect band.

name: EKS Upgrade Readiness Check
description: Deploy an EKS 1.32 cluster with Karpenter v1.0.2 and planted upgrade issues, then run the APEX EKS upgrade-check skill to produce a scored readiness report showing NOT READY status.
